test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper has found that the selling price of the product is 90% of the cost price. The selling price is Rs. 90 per kg, so in order to get a profit, he weighs only 800 grams in place of 1 kg. Determine the profit (in Rs.) earned by the shopkeeper on selling 1 kg of this product.
solution:
**Given:**

The selling Price is 90% of the Cost Price.

Selling price of the product per kg = Rs. 90

The shopkeeper gives 800 grams instead of 1 kg.

**Concept Used: **

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

**Solution:**

∵ Selling Price = 90% × Cost Price

90 = 90% × Cost Price

⇒ Cost Price = 90/90%<
